dataset: Ex Games Living Map — Northland Located Participant Population 001

method.description: Bounded Northland discovery seeded from the current Kiwi Coast Groups & Projects directory and expanded with direct public evidence for named conservation practitioners.
method.governingRule: Evidence before inference. Located means publicly evidenced and suitable for representation on the Living Map; it does not mean participant verified or endorsed.
method.boundedness: This is a substantial integration population, not a claim of exhaustive coverage. Kiwi Coast itself reports more than 280 linked entities, so subsequent discovery can expand this package without invalidating Located status.
method.privacy: No private contact details are included. Public contact names in the source directory are retained as evidence metadata only and are not automatically converted into individual participants.
